meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求整理会议纪要时，Claude会通过lark-cli查询指定时间范围内的会议列表，获取每场会议的纪要文档与逐字稿信息，并输出结构化报告（今日概览或周报），可选生成云文档。
howto.when: 当用户说出“帮我整理这周的会议纪要”“总结最近的会议”等请求，或要求生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: Claude会查询本周会议并生成周报
Claude会默认过去7天的会议并汇总
Claude会列出今天的会议概览

howto.what_en: When the user asks to organize meeting notes, Claude uses lark-cli to search meetings within a time range, fetches meeting minutes and transcripts, and outputs a structured report (daily overview or weekly summary). Optionally creates a cloud doc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period, e.g., 'help me organize this week's meeting notes'.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes.
say_en.note: Claude will search this week's meetings and create a weekly summary.
Claude will default to the last 7 days and aggregate them.
Claude will list today's meeting overview.
